jobs.title: HR Business Partner (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
We Connect. We Create. We Commit.

Location: Schiphol or Moerdijk | Hybrid working (2 days working from home per week)

At Yusen Logistics, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As an HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in creating an environment where employees can thrive, develop and perform at their best. Working closely with managers and leadership teams, you will translate business needs and people strategies into practical HR solutions that support both employee engagement and organizational success.

This role can be based in either Schiphol or Moerdijk. To stay closely connected to both operations, you will work from the other location approximately once per week.

About Us: Yusen Logistics is one of the world's leading providers of logistics solutions, helping businesses optimize their global supply chains. With over 25,000 employees across more than 650 locations in 46 countries, we offer an inspiring work environment with diverse development opportunities. As a company with Japanese roots, we embrace the philosophy of Kaizen – the culture of continuous improvement – in all our business areas.

Your Responsibilities for :

Partner with and advise managers on a wide range of HR topics, including performance management, employee relations, talent development and employment legislation.
Translate the HR and People Strategy into practical initiatives and actions across your assigned branches.
Support and coordinate recruitment activities, helping managers attract and select the right talent.
Lead absenteeism and case management processes, supporting managers with sustainable employability and return-to-work initiatives.
Implement and embed new and existing HR policies, procedures and organisational change initiatives.
Take ownership of designated HR topics and drive continuous improvement within your area of responsibility.
Analyse HR data and prepare reports that support informed decision-making by management.
Ensure compliance with employment legislation, internal policies, quality standards and corporate guidelines.

Your Profile for :

A bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology or a related field.
Several years of experience in a broad HR advisory role, such as HR Business Partner, HR Advisor or HR Generalist.
Solid knowledge of Dutch employment law, absenteeism management and HR best practices.
Proven experience advising and influencing stakeholders at different levels within an organisation.
Affinity with operational environments such as logistics, supply chain, transportation or other fast-paced industries.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset, balancing business objectives with employee needs.
Excellent command of both Dutch and English, written and spoken.
Experience working with HR systems, HR reporting and Microsoft Office applications.

Why Yusen Logistics?

A challenging and varied HR Business Partner position within a leading international logistics organisation.
The opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people, teams and organisational development.
Hybrid working arrangements, including 2 days of working from home per week.
Flexibility to be based in Schiphol or Moerdijk, with regular presence at both locations.
Opportunities for personal and professional growth through training and development programmes.
A competitive salary and attractive benefits package.
A collaborative and supportive working environment where respect, teamwork and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Ready to make an impact?

If you are passionate about helping people and organisations succeed, and you enjoy partnering with leaders to build high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of Yusen Logistics.

jobs.title: HR Operations Specialist | BeNeLux
jobs.description:
HR is much more than administration.

It is the foundation of a great employee experience.

At SoftwareOne, we believe that attracting and retaining great talent starts long before recruitment and continues throughout every stage of the employee journey. Together, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, and HR Operations create the backbone that enables our people and business to thrive.

As we continue our growth journey and integration with Crayon, we are looking for an HR Operations Specialist
to join our People & Culture team in Amsterdam. This is a unique opportunity to become part of a small but highly impactful BeNeLux HR Operations team. Working closely with your Team Lead and partnering across HR and the business, you will help ensure operational excellence while contributing to the evolution of our HR services, processes, and employee experience.

Why this role matters

In this position, you will help shape how HR Operations supports hundreds of employees across the BeNeLux region.

Your work will directly influence:
Employee onboarding and lifecycle experiences
HR service quality and efficiency
Payroll accuracy and compliance
Data quality and HR systems management
Process improvements across the employee journey
The successful people integration and growth of our organization

In short: you will help create the operational foundation that allows our people to do their best work.

What you'll be doing

Managing employee lifecycle processes from onboarding through offboarding
Maintaining employee data and HR documentation in Workday and related systems
Supporting payroll activities for Belgium and Luxembourg
Handling employee and manager requests through ServiceNow and other HR platforms
Ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and smooth HR operations
Identifying opportunities to improve processes, service delivery, and employee experience
Collaborating with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, external providers, and business stakeholders across the region

You likely bring:

Experience in HR Operations, HR Administration, Shared Services, or Employee Services
Knowledge of employment legislation in at least one BeNeLux country
A passion for accuracy, quality, and continuous improvement
Confidence working with HR systems (we work with Workday), employee data, and operational processes
Strong organizational and stakeholder management skills
Professional Dutch and English language skills
A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in an international environment

Why join SoftwareOne?

Become part of a global company with more than 13,000 colleagues across 70+ countries
Join a collaborative and supportive People & Culture community
Help shape HR Operations during an exciting phase of business growth and integration
Work in a team where your ideas and improvements can have real impact
Hybrid working model based in Amsterdam
Learning and development opportunities to support your career growth
Competitive compensation and benefits package
Unlimited holidays

If you enjoy creating structure, improving processes, and delivering an exceptional employee experience, we'd love to hear from you.
Join us and help build the people foundation that supports the future growth of SoftwareOne.

jobs.title: HR Manager Benelux | People Operations
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global leader in virtual care, with over 100 million users and more than 500 million annual healthcare interactions. We offer the only comprehensive virtual care solution that encompasses telemedicine, mental health, wellbeing, specialist medical advice and platform services.

Our Amsterdam team is growing. We are strengthening and scaling our local People Operations to create a consistent, employee-focused HR foundation for our continued growth in the Netherlands.

Role

A hands-on, high-execution role at the heart of our people’s function.

This position plays a key role in running day-to-day HR operations while contributing to Teladoc Health's people strategy in Amsterdam as we scale.

Teladoc Health is looking for a hands-on HR Manager to take ownership of People Operations in the Netherlands. In this broad and autonomous role, you will ensure that our HR operations, recruitment and employee processes run smoothly, while acting as a trusted people partner to the Country Manager and local Management Team.

You will be the primary HR contact for employees in the Netherlands and work closely with colleagues in our regional and global People & Culture organization. Your initial focus will be on operational excellence, Dutch employment-law compliance, recruitment and employee experience. As the local HR foundation develops, you will also contribute to workforce planning, organizational development and other strategic people priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Own end-to-end HR operations: contracts, onboarding, offboarding, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and employee records
Act as the first point of contact for employees on all people-related questions, from day-one logistics to day-to-day issues
Advise the Country Manager and local Management Team on people, organization and employment matters.
Ensure full compliance with Dutch labor law and internal policies, keeping documentation and processes audit-ready
Manage recruitment end to end for open roles, from job description to offer, as the main person driving the process
Build and continuously improve onboarding so new joiners ramp up quickly and feel at home fast
Take full ownership of HR processes day to day, prioritizing operational excellence and consistent execution over ad-hoc fixes
Identify gaps in current HR processes and implement practical, scalable improvements
Maintain accurate HR systems, trackers, and reporting so leadership always has an up-to-date picture of the team
Translate global People policies into effective local practices and identify where adaptation to Dutch requirements is needed.
Contribute to strategic people topics as they arise, including workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and org design input, while keeping operational delivery as the day-to-day priority

About You!

Experience

At least five years of broad HR experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for HR operations in the Netherlands.
Sound working knowledge of Dutch employment law and local HR practices.
Experience with employee relations, absence management, payroll coordination and end-to-end recruitment.
Experience in an international, fast-growing, startup or scale-up environment is an advantage.

Languages

Professional fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Digital skills

Strong digital proficiency, including experience with HRIS, payroll interfaces, reporting tools and Microsoft 365.

Soft skills

Essential: high execution power, approachable and easy-going manners, pragmatism, clear communication, with strong judgement, ownership, discretion, the ability to set priorities independently, and eagerness to grow with the company

Education requirements

Minimum studies: relevant degree or equivalent professional experience in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.

Why join Teladoc Health

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the Dutch HR agenda within an international healthcare technology organization. You will work directly with local leadership, collaborate with an international People team and have the mandate to deliver practical improvements that employees and managers experience every day.

Compensation and Benefits

The gross monthly salary for this role ranges from EUR 5,750 to EUR 7,000 based on a 40-hour working week, excluding 8% holiday allowance. The final offer will reflect the candidate’s relevant experience and fit with the scope of the role. In addition, we offer pension contribution, travel allowance, Teladoc Academy and a hybrid working arrangement.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Consultant
jobs.description:
Corporate Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Consultant | €3.800 – €5.000

Voor een internationale organisatie in Amsterdam Zuid zoek ik een Corporate Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Consultant die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt over een brede recruitmentportefeuille.
Je komt terecht in een professionele en commerciële omgeving waar veel gebeurt. Geen recruitmentrol waarin je maandenlang aan dezelfde drie vacatures werkt: gemiddeld staan er minimaal 10 vacatures tegelijkertijd open, verspreid over verschillende disciplines.

De rol

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige recruitmentproces en werkt nauw samen met verschillende hiring managers binnen de organisatie.
De vacatures zijn zeer divers: van commerciële en specialistische functies tot Finance, HR, IT, Marketing, Facilities en andere staffuncties.
Daarnaast speelt campus recruitment een belangrijke rol. Je bent betrokken bij stages, starters, campusactiviteiten en recruitment events.

Wat ga je doen?

Zelfstandig beheren van vacatures van intake tot hire
Adviseren en challengen van hiring managers
Actief sourcen en benaderen van kandidaten
Voeren en coördineren van sollicitatiegesprekken
Beheren van meerdere vacatures en stakeholders tegelijkertijd
Onderhouden van een sterke candidate experience
Organiseren en ondersteunen van campus recruitment en events
Meedenken over employer branding en recruitmentprocessen

Profiel

Vereist:

Circa 2+ jaar ervaring binnen recruitment
Ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van recruitmentprocessen
Uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands
Goede beheersing van het Engels
Sterke communicatieve en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden
Commerciële en proactieve instelling
In staat om overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving met meerdere vacatures tegelijk

Sterke voorkeur:

Ervaring als Corporate Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist
Óf ervaring binnen recruitment consultancy/agency en klaar voor de stap naar corporate recruitment
Ervaring binnen consultancy, professional services, vastgoed of een vergelijkbare commerciële omgeving
Woonachtig in Amsterdam of goed bereisbaar naar Amsterdam Zuid

Nice to have:

Ervaring met campus recruitment
Employer branding of recruitment events
Ervaring met een brede mix van corporate functies

Voorwaarden

Salaris: €3.800 – €5.000 bruto per maand

32–40 uur per week
Permanent dienstverband
Locatie: Amsterdam Zuid

Bij 40 uur: 4 dagen per week op kantoor
Bij 32 uur: volledig op kantoor
Premievrij pensioen
28 vakantiedagen + 8% vakantiegeld
NS Business Card en vergoeding van zakelijke reiskosten
Lease-a-Bike regeling
Internationale werkomgeving met veel ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen Talent Acquisition

Interesse of benieuwd of dit bij jouw volgende stap past? Stuur me gerust een bericht.
Bij interesse ontvang je aanvullende inhoudelijke informatie over de organisatie, het team en de werkomgeving.
